description: Fetch one person's profile by id, including address and — by default — every profile field keyed by field_id, plus family members. Pair with breeze_list_profile_fields to label the field ids. Breeze: GET /api/people/{person_id}.

details.description: Defaults to true (all information). false = only id and name.

person_id.description: Numeric Breeze id of the person.

name: breeze_get_person
title: Get a person
